title: Raven
subtitle: Tri-tiltrotor eVTOL testbed
role: Founder & Lead Engineer, stealth AI hardware startup

maturity.label: Testbed built; Stage 1 of 8 in progress

pitch: A tri-tiltrotor eVTOL built on the Flightory Stallion FPV airframe and redesigned part by part in carbon-fiber composite, on an 8-stage roadmap toward coordinated multi-drone autonomy.
highlights: Tri-tiltrotor layout: two tilting wing motors and one fixed tail lift motor
Primary structure in PA612-CF15 carbon-fiber composite with carbon-fiber spar and boom tubes
FEA on the main spar, motor mounts, and tail-boom mount; CFD on the airfoil and the full airframe at cruise
Eppler E205 airfoil, CFD-optimized for a 60 to 70 km/h cruise
First subscale testbed built in Jul 2026: 1.34 m wingspan, about 2 kg of structure
Stage 1 avionics selected and integrated, with wiring designed for FAA Part 107 compliance

blocks.md: Raven is my flagship, self-directed aircraft project, started in February 2026, and the flagship aircraft of the stealth AI hardware startup I founded. It is a custom redesign on the Flightory Stallion FPV airframe: Stallion is the stock base platform, and Raven is what I am building on it, with new materials, new structure, and my own electronics selection.

rows.label: Configuration
rows.value: Tri-tiltrotor: fixed-wing cruise on the 2 wing motors, VTOL hover on all 3

rows.label: Airfoil
rows.value: Eppler E205, CFD-optimized for a 60 to 70 km/h cruise

rows.label: Airframe
rows.value: Modular: multi-segment fuselage, detachable wing panels, interchangeable payload nose, V-tail

rows.label: Testbed
rows.value: 1.34 m wingspan, about 2 kg of structure (built Jul 2026)

items: Re-specified every airframe part in CAD from the stock STLs, with new material, constraints, and geometry.
Modeled the servo-to-pushrod linkages and the snap-fit wing locks with torsion springs.
Ran FEA in SolidWorks Simulation and Ansys: static loading on the carbon-fiber main spar, the motor mounts, and the tail-boom mount.
Ran CFD in Ansys on airfoil performance and full-airframe flow at cruise.
Ran tensile and torsion tests on printed PA612-CF15 coupons and tuned the print settings for the moisture-sensitive filament.

blocks.md: Raven follows an 8-stage capability roadmap from the tilt-rotor prototype toward coordinated multi-drone autonomy. Stage 1, the mechanical build and RC flight, is in progress. Everything after it is a plan, not a result.

stages.title: Mechanical build and RC flight
stages.desc: The tilt-rotor prototype under manual RC control.

entries.title: Stage 1 avionics in
entries.md: Servos and electronics soldered, waterproofed, and installed. The Stage 1 avionics are the flight controller, ESCs, motors, receiver, and GPS.

entries.title: First subscale testbed built
entries.md: Largely 3D-printed: 1.34 m wingspan and about 2 kg of structure.

entries.title: Project start
entries.md: Began the custom redesign on the Flightory Stallion FPV airframe.
